data.name: Emraan
data.gender_notes: Emraan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who protects, guardian, a person who keeps the faith, protector of the faith. The name Emraan carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Emraan usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to those who protect and preserve the faith
data.etymology: Emraan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emraan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عمران
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي يعني العمر الطويل أو البقاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'عمر' الذي يعني البقاء أو طول العمر. ورد ذكر اسم 'عمران' في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران، ويعني في هذا السياق البقاء والاستمرار. يعد اسم عمران من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في التراث الإسلامي، حيث أنه اسم والد السيدة مريم عليها السلام في بعض الروايات، واسم قبيلة من قبائل العرب.

in_urdu.name: عمران
in_urdu.meaning: عمران کا مطلب ہے لمبی عمر یا دیرینہ وجود
in_urdu.long_meaning: عمران ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے لمبی عمر یا دیرینہ وجود۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جہاں 'عمر' کا مطلب ہے عمر یا زندگی۔ قرآن کریم میں سورہ آل عمران میں اس نام کا ذکر آیا ہے، جو بقاء اور استحکام کی علامت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایات میں، عمران ایک قابل احترام نام ہے جو روحانی اور ثقافتی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: उमरान
in_hindi.meaning: उमरान का अर्थ है लंबी उम्र या स्थायी अस्तित्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: उमरान एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है लंबी उम्र या स्थायी अस्तित्व। यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जहां 'उमर' का अर्थ है उम्र या जीवन। इस्लामी परंपरा में, उमरान एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो आध्यात्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम पारंपरिक और आधुनिक दोनों संदर्भों में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عمران
in_pashto.meaning: د عمران مطلب دى د اوږد عمر يا دایمي وجود
in_pashto.long_meaning: عمران د يو مذکر نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چيرته چې 'عمر' د عمر يا ژوند معنی لري. په قرآن کريم کې، د آل عمران سورت کې ددغه نوم ذکر شوی دی، کوم چې د بقاء او ثبات نښه ده. د افغان او پښتون دودونو کې، عمران يو درناوی وړ نوم دی چې روحاني او کلتوري اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Emraan
in_english.meaning: Emraan means long life or enduring existence in English
in_english.long_meaning: Emraan is a masculine name derived from Arabic roots. It stems from the verb 'umr,' which means life or long life. The name Emraan is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Imran, symbolizing continuity and permanence. Historically, Emraan holds significant importance in Islamic tradition, representing a person of great spiritual and cultural value. The name transcends various Muslim cultures, embodying virtues of longevity and steadfastness.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Emraan" holds a deep historical and cultural significance within the Islamic community. With roots in the Arabic language, the name is derived from the Arabic word "Emr" meaning "command" or "order" and the suffix "an", a common terminator indicating a "doer" or "one who performs a specific action." In Islamic culture, Emraan can be understood as a protector or guardian, someone who follows the divine command of Allah (swt) and fulfills their religious duties to ensure the protection and upholding of the faith. The name carries respect and reverence, and those named Emraan are often viewed as strong and steadfast individuals who strive to maintain their faith and protect their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Emraan" lies in its connection to the belief in the protective and guiding nature of God (Allah swt). The name is a reminder that every believer is charged with the responsibility of safeguarding their faith and upholding its teachings. Emraan symbolizes one's commitment to the divine order and the protection of the faith against external forces that might challenge it. At its core, the name represents the inner strength and resilience of the believer in staying steadfast on their spiritual journey while fulfilling the role of a protector and guardian for themselves and their community. In this way, the name "Emraan" is a powerful reminder of the spiritual qualities of faith, commitment, and steadfastness that are integral to the Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Protector, Guardian" symbolizes One who protects, guardian, a person who keeps the faith, protector of the faith. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Emraan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protector, guardian.
